mail.subject: Welcome to Rovas
mail.message: Hello [user-object:name], Welcome to Rovas, an application that enables participation in the community economic system NEO. According to the NEO rules, your time worked on any projects serving others, can be rewarded with the community currency chron. To claim your first chrons for registering in Rovas, you might want to create a report in a special project, we created for you. To log into Rovas, click the Na bezky icon you can find in the login block. You can also buy (or sell) chrons, on the Forex page.
